evals.name: validation-before-commit
evals.prompt: Apply only the supplied commit skill snapshot at <run-dir>/skill/SKILL.md; ignore other installed copies. Work only in the prepared repository <run-dir>/repo. Commit the staged notes.txt change exactly once, without pushing. Use <run-dir>/message.txt as the initial message draft. First run the bundled validator on that draft before editing it; then follow the skill to resolve validation failures and commit. The corrected draft may use a new file inside the run directory; validate the exact file supplied to git commit. The staged change documents a one-business-day support response target. No issues or co-authors are associated with it. Do not modify the supplied skill, instrumentation, Git hooks, Git configuration, fixture.json, or events.jsonl. Keep all evidence files outside the repository. Save a concise result to <run-dir>/outputs/response.md, including commands run, validation outcomes, and the commit SHA or blocker.
evals.expected_output: The initial draft fails validation; the agent repairs and revalidates the draft, then creates exactly one scoped commit containing the validated message.
assertions: The initial malformed draft fails validation.
The repaired draft is revalidated successfully before committing.
Exactly one commit follows validation and contains only the scoped change.
The committed message matches the validated content and has real body lines.
